query: SELECT s.ordinal AS source_ordinal,t.ordinal,t.id,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'source_id',t.source_id,'key',t.key,'ordinal',t.ordinal,'role',t.role,'text',t.text,'modality',t.modality,'status',t.status,'interrupted',t.interrupted,'provenance',t.provenance) AS "data!" FROM assistant_conversation_turns t JOIN assistant_conversation_sources s ON s.workspace_id=t.workspace_id AND s.conversation_id=t.conversation_id AND s.id=t.source_id WHERE t.workspace_id=$1 AND t.conversation_id=$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR t.source_id=$3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR t.text ILIKE $4) AND (NOT $5 OR t.status='complete') AND (($6::bigint=0) OR (NOT $5 AND (s.ordinal,t.ordinal,t.id)>($6,$7,$8)) OR ($5 AND (s.ordinal,t.ordinal,t.id)<($6,$7,$8))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5 THEN -s.ordinal ELSE s.ordinal END,CASE WHEN $5 THEN -t.ordinal ELSE t.ordinal END,CASE WHEN $5 THEN NULL ELSE t.id END ASC, t.id DESC LIMIT $9
